technical_references.claims: The build API exposes distinct BG and sprite palette loaders and TILE_USE_SPRITE_PALETTE for choosing the sprite palette on BG tiles.
SMS/GG color tables, the shared sprite palette, background palette selection, and sprite palette index-0 transparency semantics.
SMS CRAM palette behavior and distinction between background color 0 and transparent sprite color 0.

hardware.sms_rgb_components: 2 bits per RGB channel; legal decoded values 0, 85, 170, 255
hardware.background_color_index_0: visible color for BG pixels in the selected table; BG pixels never become transparent because their color index is zero

bg_table.entries_1_15: HUD roles held stable across stages plus stage-specific colors in remaining slots
bg_table.stage_change_policy: load at scene transition or safe VBlank; keep locked during a round

sprite_table.entries_1_15: one roster-wide set of up to 15 useful colors shared by all sprite objects

bg_reuse_of_sprite_table.purpose: background tiles may reuse colors already in P1 without adding CRAM entries
conditions: tile attribute explicitly selects the sprite palette
does not change any sprite color assignment
verified in the scene palette and visual review

authoring_palette_manifests.scope: per-character source and visual-intent RGBs; not independent runtime palettes

runtime_measurements_still_required: CRAM write bytes and worst-frame VBlank cost
all sprite colors mapped to the locked roster-wide P1 table
scanline and SAT simulation remain separate from palette validity
limits: This contract defines palette ownership and accounting. It does not select or approve the final 15-color sprite mapping, certify color readability, or prove the in-ROM palette writes.
